title: Keep every workspace current from one console
summary: Bare ia outside a workspace now opens an all-workspaces view over the tracked list, and tab switches to it from a workspace's own view. Each row is read through that workspace's own ia, at most four at once, and is classed by the statuses its checks report. Select workspaces and batch one offer across them: each repository gets a new git worktree on a chore/ branch with no upstream, its package manager's install first, then the offer's steps rebuilt for the worktree, every path argument checked to stay inside it before each step runs, while the user's own checkout is touched only by git metadata operations. Afterwards each next step is a separate choice: commit as chore: <offer title>, push and open pull requests through gh when it is signed in, open a failed repository, or remove the worktrees and keep the branches. Nothing is pushed unless chosen. f finds workspaces in a folder to track, and config.json's worktreeRoot moves where the worktrees go.
